title: DAG Run Visualization
description: Same ReactFlow graph but read-only, overlaid with live run status. Nodes colored by step status. Safety decisions shown per job-type step. Animates via WebSocket events.
definitionOfDone: Read-only ReactFlow graph showing workflow run progress
Nodes colored by step status: pending=gray, running=blue, succeeded=green, failed=red
Safety decision badges on job-type nodes
Links to individual job detail for job-type steps

implementationPlan.description: Create dashboard/src/components/workflow/RunVisualization.tsx: Read-only ReactFlow graph for workflow run visualization. Reuses same custom node components but with status overlays. Node background colors based on step status: pending=gray/muted, running=blue/accent, succeeded=green/success, failed=red/danger, skipped=transparent. Safety decision badges on job-type nodes (small Badge component). Animated pulse on running nodes (CSS animation). Edge styling: completed edges solid, pending edges dashed. Subscribes to WebSocket events for live updates (invalidates useRun query).
implementationPlan.note: Created RunVisualization with RunNode (status-colored border/bg, safety decision badges, pulse animation on running), read-only ReactFlow graph, edge styling (solid green for completed deps, dashed for pending, animated for running).

implementationPlan.description: Add click handlers on job-type nodes: clicking navigates to /jobs/:jobId for the corresponding job. Non-job nodes show tooltip with step details on hover.
implementationPlan.note: Added tooltip with step details (type, status, started/completed times, safety decision) on all nodes. Job-type node click navigates to /jobs/:jobId.
